snippet.title: Cupiclaw - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder. Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines... and claw back your relationship! Oh, no! Morris lost his engagement ring and is too broke to buy another! Luckily, beautiful rings can be won on the top floor of the arcade.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967670/Cupiclaw/
